title: Data Table
subtitle: Powerful Data Table Component for Svelte 5
description: A flexible, type-safe data table component with sorting, pagination, custom rendering, and server-side data support.

features.title: Features
features.pagination: Full pagination with customizable page sizes
features.custom_render: Custom cell/header rendering via Svelte 5 Snippets
features.typescript: Full TypeScript generics for type safety

basic.title: 1. Basic Table
basic.description: Simple table display with minimal configuration

sorting.title: 2. Sortable Columns
sorting.description: Click column headers to sort data in ascending, descending, or no order

pagination.title: 3. Client-side Pagination
pagination.description: Paginate data on the client with customizable page sizes

server.title: 4. Server-side Pagination
server.description: Load data page-by-page from a server for large datasets

custom_cells.title: 5. Custom Cell Rendering
custom_cells.description: Use Snippets to render custom content like badges, buttons, and formatted values

row_actions.title: 6. Row Click & Styling
row_actions.description: Handle row clicks and apply conditional styling based on data
row_actions.no_clicks: Click a row to see details

combined.title: 7. Full-featured Example
combined.description: Combining sorting, pagination, filtering, and custom rendering

variants.title: 8. Style Variants
variants.description: Choose from multiple built-in styles to match your design
